race.comment: HAWAIIAN BLOOM (5) is ready to win again after going under by just under a length as fav at Dalby, and her previous third at this track had merit when struggling to get clear. Only needs to hold her from to be in the finish. EINSTAG (4) let down his supporters here last time but did have some trouble getting clear in the lane. His Ipswich second in BM60 company reads well for this. Can give another look. JOHNNY THE KID (1) returned a winner in a BM52 at this track, and the 3kg claim helps with the top weight. INQUISITOR (3) backs up from a Ballina fifth where he was held up on the home turn before making ground, and his Sunny Coast fourth two back keeps him right in the mix.
